title: Sobolev maps between manifolds
summary: First-order local Sobolev classes of maps between C¹ manifolds: the vector-valued local classes W^{1,p}_loc(Ω;F) on finite-dimensional domains with gluing and chain rules (T1); chartwise null sets equal Riemannian null sets; the continuous class W^{1,p}_loc(M,N) with atlas independence and the weak differential (T2); the operator norm and the L^p characterisation (T3); the oriented Jacobian, Hadamard's inequality and Jacobian measures (T4); the extrinsic description through C¹ immersions (T5); Euclidean compatibility (T6); and the embedding-independent class of measurable maps into a closed manifold (T7).

targets.name: MemLpLoc
targets.statement: For a topological space X with a measure μ, s ⊆ X, p : ℝ≥0∞ and g : X → B into a normed group, MemLpLoc μ p s g means MemLp g p (μ.restrict K) for every compact K ⊆ s.
hypotheses: X topological space with MeasurableSpace and a measure μ

api.name: MemLpLoc.mono_set
api.statement: t ⊆ s and MemLpLoc μ p s g give MemLpLoc μ p t g; every g satisfies MemLpLoc μ p ∅ g.

api.name: MemLpLoc.add / const_smul / of_le_mul
api.statement: Closed under sums and scalar multiples; if ‖g' x‖ ≤ c x ‖g x‖ a.e. on s with c bounded on compact subsets of s and g' a.e.-strongly measurable on compacts, then MemLpLoc μ p s g'; in particular A ∘ g for continuous linear A; a.e.-equal functions have the same membership.

api.name: MemLpLoc.of_exponent_le
api.statement: If μ is finite on compact sets and p ≤ q, MemLpLoc μ q s g gives MemLpLoc μ p s g.

api.name: ContinuousOn.memLpLoc
api.statement: X Hausdorff, opens measurable, μ finite on compacts, g continuous on s ⇒ MemLpLoc μ p s g for every p.

api.name: memLpLoc_one_iff_locallyIntegrableOn
api.statement: X locally compact, s locally closed ⇒ (MemLpLoc μ 1 s g ↔ LocallyIntegrableOn g s μ).

api.name: MemLpLoc.iUnion
api.statement: X locally compact, s = ⋃ sᵢ with sᵢ open, MemLpLoc μ p sᵢ g for all i ⇒ MemLpLoc μ p s g.

api.name: memLpLoc_congr_measure
api.statement: If for each compact K ⊆ s there is C with ν|K ≤ C μ|K and μ|K ≤ C ν|K, then MemLpLoc μ p s g ↔ MemLpLoc ν p s g.

tests.name: id_real_memLpLoc_not_memLp
tests.statement: id : ℝ → ℝ satisfies MemLpLoc volume p univ for all p but MemLp on ℝ for no p (∫|x|ᵖ = ∞, unbounded); a global-Lᵖ definition fails.

tests.name: abs_rpow_neg_half
tests.statement: g = |x|^(−1/2): ∫_{−1}^{1}|x|^{−p/2} = 4/(2−p) for p < 2 (= 4 at p = 1), infinite at p = 2; MemLpLoc p univ iff p < 2; MemLpLoc ∞ (ℝ ∖ {0}).

tests.name: inv_on_unit_interval
tests.statement: g = 1/x on (0,1): MemLpLoc ∞ (0,1) (bounded by 1/a on [a,b]) yet ∫_0^1 1/x = ∞; a definition through bounded subsets rejects it.

tests.name: empty_set
tests.statement: MemLpLoc μ p ∅ g holds for every g.

tests.name: planar_agreement
tests.statement: For X = ℂ with volume this is PseudoholomorphicCurveAnalysis PH1.1's MemLpLoc, literally.

targets.name: MemW1pLoc
targets.statement: For an additive Haar measure μ on a finite-dimensional real normed space E, Ω : Opens E, 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞ and u : E → F (F finite-dimensional), MemW1pLoc μ p Ω u means MemLpLoc μ p Ω u ∧ ∃ U : E → E →L[ℝ] F, TauCeti.HasWeakFDerivOn μ Ω u U ∧ MemLpLoc μ p Ω U.
hypotheses: E, F finite-dimensional real normed spaces with Borel σ-algebras

api.name: memW1pLoc_congr_addHaar
api.statement: For additive Haar μ, μ' on E: MemW1pLoc μ p Ω u ↔ MemW1pLoc μ' p Ω u, with the same weak derivatives.

api.name: MemW1pLoc.congr_ae
api.statement: Modifying u or U on a μ-null set changes neither membership nor the weak-derivative relation.

api.name: MemW1pLoc.add / const_smul / clm_comp
api.statement: Sums, scalar multiples and A ∘ u for A : F →L[ℝ] F' are members with D(A ∘ u) = A ∘ Du.

api.name: memW1pLoc_iff_coord
api.statement: For a basis (f_j) of F: MemW1pLoc μ p Ω u ↔ ∀ j, MemW1pLoc μ p Ω (f_j^* ∘ u), with Du = Σ_j D(f_j^* ∘ u) · f_j; products split componentwise.

api.name: ContDiffOn.memW1pLoc
api.statement: u C¹ on Ω ⇒ MemW1pLoc μ p Ω u for every p with weak derivative fderiv u; constants have weak derivative 0.

api.name: MemW1pLoc.of_exponent_le / mono
api.statement: p ≤ q gives W^{1,q}_loc ⊆ W^{1,p}_loc; restriction to Ω' ≤ Ω preserves membership with the same derivative.

tests.name: id_memW1pLoc
tests.statement: id : E → E (E ≠ 0) is a member for every p with Du = id constant, but not in global W^{1,p}(E).

tests.name: log_norm_plane
tests.statement: u = log|x| on ℝ²: |Du| = 1/|x|, ∫_{|x|<1}|x|^{−p} = 2π/(2−p) for p < 2, infinite at p = 2; member iff p < 2; omitting the bound on Du would accept p = 2.

tests.name: heaviside_not_member
tests.statement: The Heaviside function is in L^p_loc(ℝ) but has no weak derivative (∫ U φ = φ(0) impossible); an a.e.-classical-derivative definition accepts it.

tests.name: cantor_not_member
tests.statement: The Cantor function on (0,1) has classical derivative 0 a.e. but is not in W^{1,1}_loc: members are absolutely continuous on compact subintervals (TauCeti.HasWeakLineDerivOn.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval), the Cantor function is not (TauCeti.not_absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_cantorFunction).

tests.name: empty_domain
tests.statement: Ω = ∅: every u is a member.

tests.name: planar_agreement
tests.statement: For E = ℂ with volume, MemW1pLoc volume p Ω u is PseudoholomorphicCurveAnalysis PH1.1's MemWkpLoc p Ω 1 u.

targets.name: hasWeakFDerivOn_iUnion
targets.statement: Let (Ωᵢ)_{i∈ι} be open subsets of E with union Ω. If TauCeti.HasWeakFDerivOn μ Ωᵢ u Uᵢ for every i, there is U with TauCeti.HasWeakFDerivOn μ Ω u U and U = Uᵢ μ-a.e. on Ωᵢ for every i. Consequently MemW1pLoc μ p Ω u ↔ ∀ i, MemW1pLoc μ p Ωᵢ u.

tests.name: sign_half_planes
tests.statement: sign(x₁) is a member on {x₁>0} and {x₁<0} (Du = 0) but not on ℝ²; the two half-planes do not cover ℝ², and a gluing over covers up to null sets would wrongly accept it.

tests.name: log_norm_cover
tests.statement: log|x| ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(ℝ²∖{0}) for all p and ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(B(0,1)) iff p < 2; the cover {ℝ²∖{0}, B(0,1)} gives membership on ℝ² exactly for p < 2.

tests.name: empty_cover
tests.statement: Empty index set: Ω = ∅ and both sides hold.

targets.name: memW1pLoc_iff_forall_w1p
targets.statement: For E a finite-dimensional real inner product space and F = ℝ: MemW1pLoc μ p Ω u ↔ for every V : Opens E with closure compact and contained in Ω, ∃ w : TauCeti.W1p μ V p with value w =ᵐ[μ.restrict V] u; then Du = ⟪∇w, ·⟫ a.e. on V.
hypotheses: E finite-dimensional real inner product space

tests.name: coordinate_function
tests.statement: u = x₁ on ℝ², V = B(0,1/2): w ∈ W1p with gradient e₁ and Du = ⟪e₁,·⟫.

tests.name: log_norm_p2
tests.statement: u = log|x|, p = 2, V = B(0,1/2): no w ∈ W1p μ V 2 has value u since ∫_V |x|^{−2} = ∞.

tests.name: abs_p_infty
tests.statement: u = |x| on ℝ, p = ∞: on bounded V the restriction lies in W1p μ V ∞ with gradient sign x; on V = ℝ (not relatively compact) it does not.

targets.name: addHaar_preimage_eq_zero_of_isInvertible_fderiv
targets.statement: (i) If θ : E' → E is differentiable on A with μ'(A) = 0 and finrank E' ≤ finrank E, then μ(θ '' A) = 0. (ii) If θ is C¹ on open Ω' ⊆ E' with fderiv θ y invertible for every y ∈ Ω', then μ'(Ω' ∩ θ⁻¹' S) = 0 for every S with μ S = 0.
hypotheses: μ, μ' additive Haar measures on E, E'
ContDiffOn ℝ 1 θ Ω' and ∀ y ∈ Ω', (fderiv ℝ θ y).IsInvertible for (ii)

locator.where: Ch. 6 (sets of measure zero, images under C¹ maps)

tests.name: projection
tests.statement: (x,y) ↦ x maps the null set ℝ×{0} onto ℝ: dimension hypothesis used.

tests.name: constant_map
tests.statement: A constant map of ℝ² pulls a point back to ℝ²: invertibility used.

tests.name: cantor_function_image
tests.statement: The Cantor function maps the null Cantor set onto [0,1]; differentiability on A is used.

targets.name: HasWeakFDerivOn.comp_of_isInvertible_fderiv
targets.statement: Let θ : E' → E be C¹ on open Ω' with θ '' Ω' ⊆ Ω and fderiv θ y invertible on Ω'. If TauCeti.HasWeakFDerivOn μ Ω u U then TauCeti.HasWeakFDerivOn μ' Ω' (u ∘ θ) (fun y => U (θ y) ∘L fderiv ℝ θ y); if MemW1pLoc μ p Ω u then MemW1pLoc μ' p Ω' (u ∘ θ) for 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞, with D(u ∘ θ) = (Du ∘ θ) Dθ a.e. (T1(a)).

tests.name: square_map
tests.statement: θ(z) = z² on ℂ∖{0}, u = log|w|: Du(z²)(2zh) = ⟪z²,2zh⟫/|z|⁴ = 2⟪z,h⟫/|z|² = D(2 log|z|)h.

tests.name: unbounded_derivative
tests.statement: θ(y) = y³ + y, u = |x| ∈ W^{1,∞}_loc(ℝ): D(u∘θ) = (3y²+1) sign y ∈ L^∞_loc but not L^∞(ℝ).

tests.name: w1p_compL_agreement
tests.statement: E' = E inner product, p < ∞, θ injective with ‖Dθ‖ ≤ L, |det Dθ| ≥ c > 0, F = ℝ: agrees with TauCeti.W1p.gradient_compL_ae.

tests.name: ph12_change_of_variables_agreement
tests.statement: E = E' = ℂ, p > 2, θ a C¹ diffeomorphism Ω' → Ω: the membership statement is PseudoholomorphicCurveAnalysis PH1.2's change of variables at k = 1; the covering z ↦ z² and every 1 ≤ p ≤ 2 lie outside it.

targets.name: HasWeakFDerivOn.comp_of_contDiff_of_norm_fderiv_le
targets.statement: Let G : F → F' be C¹ with ‖fderiv G v‖ ≤ L for all v. If TauCeti.HasWeakFDerivOn μ Ω u U then TauCeti.HasWeakFDerivOn μ Ω (G ∘ u) (fun x => fderiv ℝ G (u x) ∘L U x); MemW1pLoc μ p Ω u ⇒ MemW1pLoc μ p Ω (G ∘ u). No continuity of u.
hypotheses: G : F → F', ContDiff ℝ 1 G

tests.name: scalar_agreement
tests.statement: F = F' = ℝ, p < ∞, u ∈ W1p: agrees with TauCeti.W1p.hasWeakFDerivOn_comp.

tests.name: linear_G
tests.statement: G linear: the statement is D(A ∘ u) = A ∘ Du of 1.2.

tests.name: exp_square
tests.statement: G(t) = e^{t²}, u = log|x|: G(u) ≥ |x|^{−2} for |x| ≤ e^{−2}, not L¹_loc(ℝ²); bounded derivative is used.

targets.name: HasWeakFDerivOn.comp_contDiffOn_of_continuousOn
targets.statement: Let W ⊆ F be open, G : F → F' C¹ on W, u continuous on Ω with u '' Ω ⊆ W. If TauCeti.HasWeakFDerivOn μ Ω u U then TauCeti.HasWeakFDerivOn μ Ω (G ∘ u) (fun x => fderiv ℝ G (u x) ∘L U x); MemW1pLoc μ p Ω u ⇒ MemW1pLoc μ p Ω (G ∘ u) (T1(b)).

tests.name: leibniz
tests.statement: G(s,t) = st: D(u₁u₂) = u₂Du₁ + u₁Du₂ for continuous u.

tests.name: log_of_norm
tests.statement: G = log on (0,∞), u = |x| on ℝ²∖{0}: D log|x| = ⟪x,·⟫/|x|²; on ℝ² the hypothesis fails at 0 and log|x| ∉ W^{1,2}_loc(ℝ²).

tests.name: continuity_used
tests.statement: u = log|x| discontinuous, G = e^{t²} on W = ℝ: G ∘ u ∉ L¹_loc.

tests.name: ph12_composition_agreement
tests.statement: E = ℂ, p > 2, W = F: a member has a continuous representative (PH1.2 Morrey) and the statement for it is PseudoholomorphicCurveAnalysis PH1.2's composition at k = 1; G = log on W = (0,∞) lies outside it.

layers.title: Null sets and local integrability on manifolds

targets.name: isNullSet_iff_riemannianVolume_eq_zero
targets.statement: For every s ⊆ M: TauCeti.IsNullSet I s ↔ TauCeti.riemannianVolume s = 0. Hence a.e. for the Riemannian volume means outside an IsNullSet, any two continuous metrics have the same null sets, and on a finite-dimensional real inner product space with its flat metric the Riemannian volume is volume.
hypotheses: RiemannianBundle and IsContinuousRiemannianBundle on the tangent bundle

locator.where: Ch. 6 (measure zero in manifolds) and Ch. 16 (Riemannian density)

tests.name: dimension_zero
tests.statement: 0-manifold: Haar on the zero space charges {0}, so only ∅ is chartwise null; the volume is counting measure; only ∅ is null.

tests.name: unit_square
tests.statement: ℝ²: unit square volume 1 (flat) and 4 for 4(dx²+dy²) (density √det(4I₂) = 4); a segment is null for both.

tests.name: open_sets
tests.statement: Non-empty open sets are null on neither side: TauCeti.IsNullSet.interior_eq_empty and TauCeti.isOpenPosMeasure_riemannianVolume agree.

targets.name: memLpLoc_riemannianVolume_iff
targets.statement: For boundaryless M as in 3.1, g : M → B and 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞: MemLpLoc riemannianVolume p univ g ↔ ∀ x₀, MemLpLoc μ p (extChartAt I x₀).target (g ∘ (extChartAt I x₀).symm) for one (every) Haar μ on E; likewise with any atlas in the maximal atlas. So L^p_loc(M) is the same for all continuous metrics and is local.

tests.name: non_comparable_metrics
tests.statement: ℝ with dx² and e^{2x}dx²: same local classes; g = 1_{[0,∞)}e^{−x} has ∫ g dx = 1, ∫ g eˣ dx = ∞.

tests.name: zero_manifold
tests.statement: On a 0-manifold every function is locally Lᵖ.

targets.name: IsNullSet.preimage_of_isLocalDiffeomorph
targets.statement: (i) θ : M' → M with IsLocalDiffeomorph I' I 1 θ: IsNullSet I s ⇒ IsNullSet I' (θ ⁻¹' s). (ii) f : M' → M C¹ with finrank E' ≤ finrank E, and s ⊆ ⋃ₖ (extChartAt I' xₖ).source for countably many xₖ (every s when LindelofSpace M'): IsNullSet I' s ⇒ IsNullSet I (f '' s). (iii) For U : Opens M and s ⊆ U: null in U ↔ null in M.
hypotheses: M', M boundaryless C¹ manifolds with finite-dimensional models E', E
(ii) only: s covered by countably many preferred chart sources of M' (automatic under LindelofSpace M')

tests.name: circle_covering
tests.statement: t ↦ e^{it} pulls a point back to a translate of 2πℤ, countable and null.

tests.name: collapse
tests.statement: (x,y) ↦ (x,0) on ℝ² is not a local diffeomorphism and pulls the null line ℝ×{0} back to ℝ².

tests.name: projection_image
tests.statement: ℝ² → ℝ maps the null line ℝ×{0} onto ℝ: dimension hypothesis of (ii) used.

tests.name: non_lindelof_source
tests.statement: M' = ℝ × D, D = ℝ discrete, charts (x,d) ↦ x on slices; f(x,d) = d is C¹; s = {0} × D meets each chart source in one point, so is null, but f(s) = ℝ is not null; s meets uncountably many slices, so the countable-cover hypothesis of (ii) is used. With D = ℤ, f(s) = ℤ is null.

layers.title: Sobolev classes on manifolds and the weak differential

targets.name: MemW1pLocOn
targets.statement: u : M → V lies in W^{1,p}_loc(M; V) when ∀ x₀, MemW1pLoc μ p (extChartAt I x₀).target (u ∘ (extChartAt I x₀).symm) for every Haar μ; a field D : (x : M) → (TangentSpace I x →L[ℝ] V) is a weak differential (HasWeakMDeriv) when z ↦ D(φ.symm z) ∘L mfderiv of φ.symm at z is a weak derivative of u ∘ φ.symm on φ.target for every preferred chart φ.

locator.where: line 28 (W^{1,p}(M, R^ν) as the ambient class)

api.name: memW1pLocOn_iff_atlas
api.statement: Membership and weak differentials may be tested in the charts of any atlas contained in the maximal atlas.

api.name: MemW1pLocOn.exists_hasWeakMDeriv
api.statement: M Lindelöf and u a member ⇒ a weak differential exists; two agree outside a TauCeti.IsNullSet; a total choice weakMDeriv (0 off the class) is a weak differential of every member.

api.name: MemW1pLocOn.add / smul / clm_comp / congr
api.statement: Closed under sums, scalar multiples, continuous linear maps with D(A ∘ u) = A ∘ Du; unchanged by modification on a null set.

api.name: ContMDiff.memW1pLocOn
api.statement: C¹ u lies in the class for every p with weak differential mfderiv u.

api.name: MemW1pLocOn.restrict / iUnion
api.statement: Restriction to open U preserves membership; membership on every set of an open cover gives membership on M.

api.name: MemW1pLocOn.comp_isLocalDiffeomorph / comp_contDiff
api.statement: u ∘ θ for C¹ local diffeomorphisms θ with D(u∘θ) = Du(θ y) ∘ dθ_y a.e.; G ∘ u for C¹ G with bounded derivative (no continuity), and for G C¹ on an open set containing u(M) when u is continuous.

tests.name: abs_on_line
tests.statement: M = ℝ, u = |x|: member of W^{1,∞}_loc with Du = sign x a.e.

tests.name: exotic_structure
tests.statement: On ℝ with the atlas {x ↦ x³}, |x| reads |y|^{1/3} with derivative |y|^{−2/3}/3, locally Lᵖ iff p < 3/2: the class depends on the C¹ structure.

tests.name: sign_off_line
tests.statement: sign(x₁) is a member on ℝ²∖{x₁=0} with Du = 0 and not on ℝ².

tests.name: zero_manifold
tests.statement: On a 0-manifold every u is a member with weak differential 0.

targets.name: MemW1pLocMap
targets.statement: f : M → N lies in W^{1,p}_loc(M, N) when f is continuous and for all x₀ ∈ M, y₀ ∈ N and Haar μ, MemW1pLoc μ p Ω_{x₀y₀}(f) ((extChartAt J y₀) ∘ f ∘ (extChartAt I x₀).symm), where Ω_{x₀y₀}(f) = φ.target ∩ φ.symm ⁻¹' (f ⁻¹' ψ.source). Headline T2: for continuous f and atlases 𝒜 ⊆ maximalAtlas I 1 M, ℬ ⊆ maximalAtlas J 1 N covering M and N, membership of all representatives for 𝒜 × ℬ ↔ f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N) ↔ membership for all charts of both maximal atlases.
hypotheses: IsManifold I 1 M, IsManifold J 1 N

api.name: memW1pLocMap_iff_atlas
api.statement: For continuous f and covering atlases 𝒜, ℬ in the maximal atlases: f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N) iff the representatives for 𝒜 × ℬ are members, iff those for all charts are.

api.name: isOpen_localRepDomain
api.statement: Each Ω_{x₀y₀}(f) is open for continuous f.

api.name: memW1pLocMap_withMetric
api.statement: The class involves no metric; TauCeti.WithMetric copies have the same members.

api.name: MemW1pLocMap.of_exponent_le / const
api.statement: W^{1,q}_loc(M,N) ⊆ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N) for p ≤ q; constant maps are members.

api.name: memW1pLocMap_vector_iff
api.statement: For N = V with its single chart: f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,V) ↔ f continuous ∧ f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M;V).

tests.name: log_norm_discontinuous
tests.statement: log|x| ∈ W^{1,1}_loc(ℝ²;ℝ) but not in W^{1,1}_loc(ℝ²,ℝ): continuity is part of the definition.

tests.name: circle_map
tests.statement: f(t) = (cos|t|^{1/2}, sin|t|^{1/2}) : ℝ → S¹: angle-chart representative |t|^{1/2} with derivative sign(t)|t|^{−1/2}/2; member iff p < 2.

tests.name: exotic_source_structure
tests.statement: With the atlas {x ↦ x³} on the source, id lies in the class iff p < 3/2.

tests.name: identity
tests.statement: id_M is a member for every p.

targets.name: HasWeakMFDeriv
targets.statement: For continuous f, D : (x : M) → (TangentSpace I x →L[ℝ] TangentSpace J (f x)) is a weak differential when for all x₀, y₀, Haar μ, z ↦ mfderiv ψ ∘L D(φ.symm z) ∘L mfderiv φ.symm z is a weak derivative of ψ ∘ f ∘ φ.symm on Ω_{x₀y₀}(f); weakMFDeriv f is a total choice (0 when none exists). T2: existence for Lindelöf M and members, uniqueness outside an IsNullSet, chart formula in all maximal-atlas charts.

api.name: MemW1pLocMap.exists_hasWeakMFDeriv
api.statement: M Lindelöf, f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N) ⇒ ∃ D, HasWeakMFDeriv f D, and HasWeakMFDeriv f (weakMFDeriv f).

api.name: HasWeakMFDeriv.isNullSet_ne
api.statement: HasWeakMFDeriv f D → HasWeakMFDeriv f D' → TauCeti.IsNullSet I {x | D x ≠ D' x}; modifying D on a null set keeps the predicate.

api.name: HasWeakMFDeriv.chart_formula
api.statement: For all charts φ, ψ of the maximal atlases, dψ ∘ D ∘ (dφ)⁻¹ = D(ψ ∘ f ∘ φ⁻¹) ∘ φ a.e. on φ.source ∩ f⁻¹ ψ.source; chart expressions are a.e.-strongly measurable and locally Lᵖ.

api.name: weakMFDeriv_vector
api.statement: For N = V the weak differential is that of 4.1.

tests.name: chart_direction
tests.statement: M = N = ℝ, chart φ(x) = 2x, f = id: representative y/2 with derivative 1/2 and 1·Df·(1/2) = 1/2 gives Df = 1; using dφ gives 1/4.

tests.name: identity
tests.statement: f = id_M: Df = id outside a null set.

tests.name: junk_value
tests.statement: For discontinuous f, weakMFDeriv f = 0 everywhere.

tests.name: circle_map_differential
tests.statement: For the circle map at p < 2, Df(t) = sign(t)|t|^{−1/2}/2 times the angular unit vector for t ≠ 0.

targets.name: ContMDiff.memW1pLocMap
targets.statement: If f : M → N is C¹ (ContMDiff I J 1 f) then f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N) for every 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞, HasWeakMFDeriv f (mfderiv I J f), and weakMFDeriv f = mfderiv I J f outside an IsNullSet (T2).

tests.name: t_abs_t
tests.statement: f(t) = t|t| is C¹ not C²: Df = 2|t| everywhere, member for every p.

tests.name: abs_not_C1
tests.statement: |t| is not C¹ but is a member with Df = sign t: sufficient condition only.

tests.name: cantor
tests.statement: The Cantor function is C¹ off a closed null set but in no class.

targets.name: MemW1pLocMap.restrict_iff_iUnion
targets.statement: For continuous f: (i) f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N) ⇒ f|_U ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(U,N) for open U with D(f|_U) = Df|_U a.e.; (ii) an open cover (Uᵢ) with f|_{Uᵢ} members gives f a member; (iii) f(M) ⊆ W open: f member ↔ corestriction to W member; (iv) membership is the same between TauCeti.WithMetric copies and weak differentials agree outside a null set.

tests.name: circle_map_cover
tests.statement: The circle map is smooth on (0,∞) and (−∞,0) but a member on ℝ only for p < 2: the cover must contain 0.

tests.name: sign_half_planes
tests.statement: sign(x₁) on half-planes: the cover must be an open cover of all of M.

tests.name: tanh_corestriction
tests.statement: tanh : ℝ → ℝ corestricts to (−1,1) with Df = 1 − tanh².

targets.name: MemW1pLocMap.comp
targets.statement: (a) θ : M' → M with IsLocalDiffeomorph I' I 1 θ and f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N) ⇒ f ∘ θ ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M',N) with D(f∘θ)(y) = Df(θ y) ∘ dθ_y a.e.; (b) g : N → P C¹ ⇒ g ∘ f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,P) with D(g∘f)(x) = dg_{f x} ∘ Df(x) a.e. No bounds on the derivatives.

tests.name: dilation_source
tests.statement: θ(y) = 2y, f = |t|^{1/2}: D(f∘θ)(y) = 2Df(2y) = sign(y)|2y|^{−1/2}, the derivative of √2|y|^{1/2}.

tests.name: exp_to_circle
tests.statement: g(s) = (cos s, sin s), f = |t|^{1/2}: g ∘ f is the circle map, a member exactly for p < 2.

tests.name: collapse_source
tests.statement: θ(y) = (y₁,0), f = |x|^{1/2} on ℝ²: f member iff p < 4, f ∘ θ = |y₁|^{1/2} member iff p < 2; for 2 ≤ p < 4 (a) fails without the local-diffeomorphism hypothesis.

layers.title: The operator norm of the differential

targets.name: aestronglyMeasurable_norm_weakMFDeriv
targets.statement: With continuous metrics on M and N, M Lindelöf with Borel structure, and f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N): x ↦ ‖weakMFDeriv f x‖ (operator norm for g_M, g_N) is a.e.-strongly measurable for riemannianVolume; on a compact K ⊆ φ.source ∩ f⁻¹ ψ.source there is C ≥ 1 with C⁻¹‖D(ψ∘f∘φ⁻¹)(φ x)‖ ≤ ‖Df x‖ ≤ C‖D(ψ∘f∘φ⁻¹)(φ x)‖ a.e. on K; for C¹ f, ‖Df‖ = ‖mfderiv f‖ a.e.
hypotheses: RiemannianBundle and IsContinuousRiemannianBundle on M and N
LindelofSpace M, MeasurableSpace M, BorelSpace M

tests.name: scaled_target_metric
tests.statement: id from flat ℝ to (ℝ, 4dt²): ‖Df‖ = 2; model norms would give 1.

tests.name: circle_radius
tests.statement: Circle map into the unit round circle: ‖Df(t)‖ = |t|^{−1/2}/2; into the circle of radius 3: 3|t|^{−1/2}/2.

tests.name: naive_chart_norm
tests.statement: In the chart φ(x) = 2x, the representative of id has norm 1/2 while ‖Df‖ = 1.

targets.name: memW1pLocMap_iff_memLpLoc_norm
targets.statement: If f ∈ W^{1,1}_loc(M,N) and 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞ then f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N) ↔ MemLpLoc riemannianVolume p univ (fun x => ‖weakMFDeriv f x‖) (T3).

tests.name: sqrt_abs
tests.statement: f = |t|^{1/2} on flat ℝ: ‖Df‖ = |t|^{−1/2}/2 ∈ L^p_loc iff p < 2, the range of the class.

tests.name: t_log_t
tests.statement: f = t log|t|: ‖Df‖ = |log|t| + 1| in L^p_loc for all finite p, not L^∞_loc; member for all finite p, not p = ∞.

tests.name: cantor_hypothesis
tests.statement: Cantor function: classical derivative 0 a.e. but in no class; the hypothesis f ∈ W^{1,1}_loc is used.

targets.name: norm_le_of_comparable_metrics
targets.statement: If a|v| ≤ |v|' ≤ b|v| on TM and α|w| ≤ |w|' ≤ β|w| on TN (0 < a ≤ b, 0 < α ≤ β), then (α/b)‖A‖ ≤ ‖A‖' ≤ (β/a)‖A‖ for every linear A : T_xM → T_yN; hence (α/b)‖Df‖ ≤ ‖Df‖' ≤ (β/a)‖Df‖ a.e.; continuous metrics are uniformly comparable on compact sets, so T3 is metric independent.
hypotheses: two continuous metrics on M and on N with the comparison constants

tests.name: constant_rescale
tests.statement: g'_N = c² g_N: ‖A‖' = c‖A‖ attains both bounds (a = b = 1, α = β = c).

tests.name: anisotropic
tests.statement: Target ℝ² with dx² + 4dy² against flat (α = 1, β = 2): ‖id‖' = 2 = β/a.

tests.name: non_comparable
tests.statement: Target ℝ with e^{2x}dx²: ‖id‖' = eˣ, unbounded on ℝ, bounded on compacts.

targets.name: orientedJacobian
targets.statement: For real inner product spaces V, W of dimension n with orientations o_V, o_W : Orientation ℝ · (Fin n) and linear A : V → W, orientedJacobian o_V o_W A is the unique scalar c with (o_W.volumeForm).compLinearMap A = c • o_V.volumeForm; it exists by AlternatingMap.eq_smul_basis_det and is unique since o_V.volumeForm = ±1 on orthonormal bases (also for n = 0, the empty basis). Basis formula: c = o_V.volumeForm b * o_W.volumeForm (A ∘ b) for every orthonormal basis b : Fin n → V, and c = o_W.volumeForm (A ∘ b) for b positively oriented (such b exists iff n ≥ 1 or o_V is positive).
hypotheses: V, W real inner product spaces
o_V, o_W orientations indexed by Fin n

api.name: orientedJacobian_eq_volumeForm_basis
api.statement: For every orthonormal basis b : Fin n → V, J(A) = o_V.volumeForm b * o_W.volumeForm (A ∘ b); for b positively oriented, J(A) = o_W.volumeForm (A ∘ b). A positively oriented orthonormal basis exists for n ≥ 1 (Orientation.finOrthonormalBasis), not for n = 0 with o_V negative (Module.Basis.orientation_isEmpty).

api.name: orientedJacobian_comp
api.statement: J(B ∘ A) = J(B) J(A); J(id) = 1; J(cA) = cⁿ J(A).

api.name: orientedJacobian_self_eq_det
api.statement: For V = W with o_V = o_W, J(A) = LinearMap.det A.

api.name: orientedJacobian_neg_left / neg_right
api.statement: Reversing one orientation negates J; reversing both leaves it unchanged.

api.name: abs_orientedJacobian
api.statement: |J(A)| = LinearMap.normDet A; J(A) ≠ 0 ↔ A bijective; J(A) > 0 ↔ A bijective and maps o_V to o_W.

api.name: abs_orientedJacobian_le
api.statement: |J(A)| ≤ ‖A‖ⁿ (basis formula and Orientation.abs_volumeForm_apply_le on A ∘ b, b orthonormal), with equality for non-negative multiples of linear isometries.

api.name: orientedJacobian_isometry
api.statement: For linear isometric equivalences U, U', J(U' ∘ A ∘ U) = J(U') J(A) J(U) with J(U), J(U') ∈ {±1}.

api.name: continuous_orientedJacobian
api.statement: In orthonormal bases b of V and b' of W, J(A) = o_V.volumeForm b * o_W.volumeForm b' * det[A] with both signs ±1 (empty matrix, det 1, for n = 0); a polynomial in the matrix entries, hence continuous.

tests.name: diag_two_one
tests.statement: diag(2,1) on ℝ², standard orientations: J = 2 = det, normDet = 2, ‖A‖² = 4 ≥ 2.

tests.name: reflection_signs
tests.statement: R = diag(−1,1): J = −1 (std → std), +1 (std → −std); unsigned |det| cannot distinguish R from id.

tests.name: non_orthonormal_bases
tests.statement: id : ℝ² → ℝ² has matrix diag(2,1) in bases (2e₁,e₂),(e₁,e₂) with det 2, while J(id) = 1.

tests.name: pullback_direction
tests.statement: J(diag(2,1)) = 2; a definition by (A⁻¹)^* vol_V = J vol_W gives 1/2.

tests.name: dimension_zero
tests.statement: n = 0: J(A) = 1 for equal sign orientations, −1 otherwise; normDet = 1 = |J|; Hadamard 1 ≤ ‖A‖⁰ = 1. With o_V negative no positively oriented basis exists; o_W.volumeForm (A ∘ b) with b the empty basis would ignore o_V and give +1 for o_V negative, o_W positive.

targets.name: sobolevJacobian
targets.statement: For M, N of dimension n with continuous metrics and orientations o_M, o_N (TauCeti.Manifold.Orientation · · (Fin n)) and f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N): J_f x = orientedJacobian (o_M.orientationAt x) (o_N.orientationAt (f x)) (weakMFDeriv f x). Headline T4: (Df x)^*(vol_N)_{f x} = J_f x (vol_M)_x for every x with vol = TauCeti.riemannianVolumeForm; uniqueness a.e.; measurability; |J_f| = normDet(Df); sign laws; chart formula J_f(x) = ε_M(x) ε_N(f x) det[D(ψ∘f∘φ⁻¹)(φ x)] ρ_N(f x)/ρ_M(x) a.e. with ρ = TauCeti.chartVolumeDensity and det in Module.finBasis bases; C¹ case.
hypotheses: LindelofSpace M, MeasurableSpace M, BorelSpace M

api.name: sobolevJacobian_volumeForm
api.statement: (Df x)^*(riemannianVolumeForm o_N (f x)) = J_f x • riemannianVolumeForm o_M x for every x; any j with this identity a.e. equals J_f a.e.

api.name: aestronglyMeasurable_sobolevJacobian
api.statement: J_f is a.e.-strongly measurable for riemannianVolume.

api.name: abs_sobolevJacobian
api.statement: |J_f x| = normDet (Df x) for every x.

api.name: sobolevJacobian_neg
api.statement: Replacing one of o_M, o_N by its negative negates J_f; replacing both leaves it unchanged.

api.name: sobolevJacobian_chart
api.statement: J_f(x) = ε_M(x) ε_N(f x) det[D(ψ∘f∘φ⁻¹)(φ x)] ρ_N(f x)/ρ_M(x) a.e. on φ.source ∩ f⁻¹ψ.source (Lee2012 Ch. 15).

api.name: sobolevJacobian_of_contMDiff
api.statement: For C¹ f, J_f = J(mfderiv f) a.e.; J(mfderiv f x) > 0 where f is orientation preserving at x.

tests.name: line_scaled_metric
tests.statement: M = N = ℝ flat: J_f = f'; target metric 4dt²: ρ_N = 2, J_f = 2f'; a density-free determinant gives f', contradicting |J_f| = normDet = 2|f'|.

tests.name: identity_reversed
tests.statement: id : (M,o) → (M,−o), M non-empty: J_f = −1.

tests.name: fold_map
tests.statement: F(x₁,x₂) = (|x₁|,x₂): J_F = sign x₁ a.e., ‖DF‖ = 1; an unsigned Jacobian gives 1.

targets.name: abs_sobolevJacobian_le_and_memLpLoc
targets.statement: In the setting of 6.2: |J_f x| ≤ ‖Df x‖ⁿ for every x, and f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N) ⇒ MemLpLoc riemannianVolume (p/n) univ J_f (p/n in [0,∞], ∞/n = ∞); in particular J_f ∈ L¹_loc when p ≥ n ≥ 1.

tests.name: radial_stretch
tests.statement: f(x) = x|x|^{−1/2} on ℝ²: ‖Df‖ = |x|^{−1/2}, J_f = |x|^{−1}/2 ≤ |x|^{−1}; ‖Df‖ ∈ L^p_loc iff p < 4, J_f ∈ L^q_loc iff q < 2 = p/n bound.

tests.name: conformal_equality
tests.statement: λU has |J| = λⁿ = ‖λU‖ⁿ.

tests.name: bump_sum
tests.statement: Sum of λ_k(x−c_k)χ(|x−c_k|/r_k), r_k = 2^{−k}, λ_k = 2^k/√k: continuous, W^{1,p}_loc for p < 2, inner halves contribute π/(4k) to ∫J_f, divergent: J_f ∉ L¹_loc for p < n.

targets.name: jacobianMeasure
targets.statement: For f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N) with MemLpLoc riemannianVolume 1 univ J_f: μ_f^± = riemannianVolume.withDensity (ENNReal.ofReal (max (±J_f) 0)); the Jacobian measure is μ_f^+ − μ_f^− on relatively compact Borel sets. Theorem: with N also Lindelöf with MeasurableSpace N, BorelSpace N, for a C¹ open embedding f orientation preserving at every point, μ_f^− = 0 and μ_f^+ A = riemannianVolume (f '' A) for Borel A, f '' A being Borel (Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.measurableEmbedding) (roles exchanged if orientation reversing everywhere).
hypotheses: for the change-of-variables theorem: LindelofSpace N, MeasurableSpace N, BorelSpace N (so that vol_N = TauCeti.riemannianVolume of N is defined)

api.name: isLocallyFiniteMeasure_jacobianMeasure
api.statement: μ_f^± are locally finite and absolutely continuous with respect to riemannianVolume.

api.name: jacobianMeasure_neg
api.statement: Reversing one orientation exchanges μ_f^+ and μ_f^−; J_f ≥ 0 a.e. gives μ_f^− = 0.

api.name: jacobianMeasure_le
api.statement: μ_f^+(A) + μ_f^−(A) ≤ ∫_A ‖Df‖ⁿ dvol_M.

api.name: jacobianMeasure_of_openEmbedding
api.statement: N Lindelöf with MeasurableSpace N, BorelSpace N; f a C¹ open embedding, orientation preserving everywhere: μ_f^− = 0 and μ_f^+(A) = vol_N(f(A)) for Borel A (f(A) Borel by Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.measurableEmbedding).

tests.name: reflection
tests.statement: f(x) = −x: μ_f^+ = 0, μ_f^−([0,1]) = 1; a density |J_f| cannot distinguish f from id.

tests.name: square_multiplicity
tests.statement: f(z) = z² on ℂ∖{0}, A = {1<|z|<2}: μ_f^+(A) = 2π∫_1^2 4r³dr = 30π while area f(A) = 15π; injectivity is used.

targets.name: memW1pLocMap_opens_iff
targets.statement: For finite-dimensional real inner product spaces E, F with flat metrics, Ω : Opens E as a manifold with the restricted metric, f : Ω → F and f̃ : E → F with f = f̃ ∘ Subtype.val: f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(Ω,F) ↔ ContinuousOn f̃ Ω ∧ MemW1pLoc volume p Ω f̃; then Df = U a.e., riemannianVolume of Ω = volume.restrict Ω, ‖Df‖ = ‖U‖ a.e., and for F = E with orientation o on both sides (TauCeti.Manifold.Orientation.model o, restricted to Ω), J_f = LinearMap.det U a.e. (T6).
hypotheses: E, F finite-dimensional real inner product spaces

tests.name: identity
tests.statement: f = id_Ω: Df = id, ‖Df‖ = 1, J_f = 1.

tests.name: reflection
tests.statement: (x₁,x₂) ↦ (x₁,−x₂): J_f = −1.

tests.name: complex_square
tests.statement: z ↦ z² with orientation (1,i): J_f = 4|z|² = |∂f/∂z|² − |∂f/∂z̄|².

tests.name: radial_stretch
tests.statement: x|x|^{−1/2}: weak and classical derivatives agree off 0, J_f = |x|^{−1}/2.

layers.title: Immersions, embeddings and the extrinsic class

targets.name: exists_contMDiffOn_retraction_of_injective_mfderiv
targets.statement: If ι : N → V is C¹ (ContMDiff J 𝓘(ℝ,V) 1 ι) and mfderiv ι y₀ is injective, there are open U ∋ y₀, open t ⊆ V with ι '' U ⊆ t and r : V → N, ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ,V) J 1 r t, with r (ι y) = y for y ∈ U. No injectivity of ι.

tests.name: unit_circle
tests.statement: Inclusion of the unit circle in ℝ²: r(v) = v/|v| on ℝ²∖{0}.

tests.name: cube_map
tests.statement: ι(s) = s³: the left inverse s^{1/3} is not differentiable at 0; injective differential is used.

tests.name: figure_eight
tests.statement: The figure-eight immersion is not injective but has local retractions on patches.

targets.name: memW1pLocMap_iff_comp_immersion
targets.statement: Let ι : N → V be C¹ with injective mfderiv everywhere and f : M → N continuous. Then f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N) ↔ ι ∘ f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M;V), and D(ι∘f)(x) = dι_{f x} ∘ Df(x) a.e.; if V is an inner product space and ⟪dι v, dι w⟫ = g_N(v,w), then ‖D(ι∘f)(x)‖ = ‖Df(x)‖ a.e. for every continuous metric on M (T5).
hypotheses: ∀ y, Injective (mfderiv J 𝓘(ℝ,V) ι y)
isometry hypothesis for the norm statement

tests.name: circle_isometric
tests.statement: Unit circle in ℝ², circle map f: |D(ι∘f)| = |t|^{−1/2}/2 = ‖Df‖; with 2ι the left side doubles.

tests.name: cube_not_immersion
tests.statement: ι(s) = s³, f = t^{1/3}: ι∘f = id smooth while Df = t^{−2/3}/3 ∈ L^p_loc iff p < 3/2.

tests.name: double_cover
tests.statement: ι = z ↦ z² on S¹, f(t) = (cos(|t|^{1/2}/2), sin(|t|^{1/2}/2)): ι∘f is the circle map; both members exactly for p < 2.

targets.name: MemExtrinsicW1pLoc
targets.statement: For ι : N → V and any u : M → N, u ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M,N;ι) when ι ∘ u ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M;V) (4.1). No continuity required.

api.name: MemExtrinsicW1pLoc.congr_isNullSet
api.statement: Membership is unchanged by modifying u on a TauCeti.IsNullSet.

api.name: memExtrinsicW1pLoc_iff_ae_mem_range
api.statement: For injective ι and non-empty N: v ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M;V) with v(x) ∈ ι(N) outside a null set ↔ v = ι ∘ u outside a null set for some member u.

api.name: memExtrinsicW1pLoc_iff_of_continuous
api.statement: For a C¹ immersion ι, continuous members are exactly W^{1,p}_loc(M,N) (8.2).

api.name: MemExtrinsicW1pLoc.comp_isLocalDiffeomorph
api.statement: Precomposition with C¹ local diffeomorphisms of the source preserves the class.

tests.name: hedgehog
tests.statement: x/|x| : B³ → S² ⊆ ℝ³: |D(ι∘u)|_HS = √2/|x|, ∫_{B³}|x|^{−p} = 4π∫_0^1 r^{2−p}dr finite iff p < 3; member for 1 ≤ p < 3, in no continuous class.

tests.name: sign_into_S0
tests.statement: sign(x₁) : B² → S⁰ ⊆ ℝ has a jump: in no class.

tests.name: lp_only_model
tests.statement: A model asking only ι ∘ u ∈ L^p_loc would accept sign(x₁).

targets.name: memW1pLocOn_comp_embedding_iff
targets.statement: For compact boundaryless N and C¹ embeddings ι₁ : N → V₁, ι₂ : N → V₂ (Manifold.IsSmoothEmbedding J 𝓘(ℝ,Vᵢ) 1 ιᵢ) and any u : M → N: ι₁ ∘ u ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M;V₁) ↔ ι₂ ∘ u ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M;V₂); for every compactly supported C¹ G : V₁ → V₂ with G ∘ ι₁ = ι₂ (such G exist), D(ι₂∘u) = DG(ι₁∘u) ∘ D(ι₁∘u) a.e. (T7).
hypotheses: Manifold.IsSmoothEmbedding J 𝓘(ℝ,V₁) 1 ι₁ and J 𝓘(ℝ,V₂) 1 ι₂

tests.name: noncompact_target
tests.statement: N = ℝ, ι₁ = id, ι₂(s) = (s, exp(exp s)), M = B(0,e^{−1}), u = log log(1/|x|): ι₁∘u ∈ W^{1,2}_loc (∫_0^{1/e} dr/(r log²(1/r)) < ∞) but the second coordinate of ι₂∘u is 1/|x|, not W^{1,1}_loc.

tests.name: double_cover_not_embedding
tests.statement: ι₁ = z ↦ z² on S¹, ι₂ inclusion, u = e^{iθ/2} on the punctured disc: ι₁∘u = z/|z| smooth, ι₂∘u jumps across the positive real axis.

tests.name: two_embeddings_circle
tests.statement: Inclusion S¹ ⊆ ℝ² and z ↦ (z,z²) into ℝ⁴ with u = x/|x| on the disc: both compositions in L^p_loc-gradient class iff p < 2.

suppliers.what: Orientations, tangent orientations and orientation-preserving maps, metrics on open subsets, the Riemannian volume form and measure, consumed through their Tau Ceti implementations (TauCeti.Manifold.Orientation, TauCeti.riemannianVolumeForm, TauCeti.riemannianVolume, TauCeti.Manifold.instRiemannianBundleOpen).

The planar local classes MemLpLoc and MemWkpLoc (PH1.1), used only in the agreement Checks of 1.1 and 1.2; the composition and change-of-variables theorems for kp > 2 (PH1.2), used at k = 1 only in the agreement Checks of 2.2 and 2.4.

consumers.what: W^{1,n}_loc(M,N), Df, ‖Df‖, J(A), J_f, Hadamard's inequality, the chain rules and the Euclidean case: its requirements map to 4.2/4.4/4.5 (class), 3.1/4.3 (weak differential, null sets), 5.1–5.3 (norm), 6.1–6.3 (Jacobian), 3.3/4.6 (chain rules), 1.2/7.1 (Euclidean case).
PH4.1's W^{1,p}_loc(Σ,M) for a boundaryless Riemann surface and p > 2 coincides with 4.2; a Check of PH4.1 against 4.2.
Density of smooth maps, traces, homotopy classes, metric-space targets, higher order, approximate differentiability and tangency, (p-)harmonic maps; consumes 8.3–8.4.
